title: Alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <rect x='24' y='78' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <rect x='68' y='78' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <!-- left foot -->
  <rect x='18' y='86' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <!-- right foot -->
  <rect x='66' y='86' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <!-- left bell -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='22' r='12' fill='#e9c46a'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='22' r='7' fill='#f4d58d'/>
  <!-- right bell -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='22' r='12' fill='#e9c46a'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='22' r='7' fill='#f4d58d'/>
  <!-- bell tops -->
  <rect x='18' y='8' width='8' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <rect x='74' y='8' width='8' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <!-- hammer -->
  <rect x='46' y='10' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <rect x='44' y='6' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='14' y='26' width='72' height='58' rx='20' fill='#2a9d8f'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='20' y='32' width='60' height='46' rx='15' fill='#3dbfae'/>
  <!-- clock face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='24' fill='#fff3c4'/>
  <!-- clock face inner ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='20' fill='#ffe8a3'/>
  <!-- hour marks -->
  <rect x='48' y='36' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <rect x='48' y='72' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <rect x='30' y='54' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <rect x='66' y='54' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <!-- hour hand -->
  <rect x='47' y='52' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#264653'/>
  <!-- minute hand -->
  <rect x='48' y='42' width='4' height='16' rx='2' fill='#264653'/>
  <!-- center dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='3' fill='#e76f51'/>
  <!-- left ear/top -->
  <rect x='12' y='28' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#264653'/>
  <!-- right ear/top -->
  <rect x='82' y='28' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#264653'/>
  <!-- shine on body -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#7be0d0'/>
</svg>
